result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: subscription use extends to Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer’s behalf; revocation or suspension is limited to an uncured material breach after notice and cure opportunity; paid-up and embedded licences are perpetual and irrevocable; and transfers to successors are permitted subject to Section 24. The revision is confined to correcting the restrictive subscription grant and preserves the remaining commercial terms. Drafting is professional, though Section 13.3’s phrase “except during a material uncured ... breach” would be clearer as “except for an uncured material ... breach.”
